# ataila_licence (Data Source)

The platform's licence, as the licence gate sees it. The installed bundle is never read into the state. Needs `licence-read-global` or `licence-admin-global`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ataila_licence" "this" {}

output "licence" {
  value = {
    state       = data.ataila_licence.this.state
    tier        = data.ataila_licence.this.tier
    modules     = data.ataila_licence.this.modules
    valid_until = data.ataila_licence.this.valid_until
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `bound_fqdn` (String) The name the installed licence is bound to.
- `days_remaining` (Number) Whole days until `valid_until`; negative in grace.
- `document_digest` (String) sha256 (hex) of the installed licence document.
- `fqdn` (String) The name the platform answers on, as the licence engine derives it.
- `grace_days` (Number) Days of grace after the term.
- `growth_allowed` (Boolean) The licence lets the platform grow (projects, AI, customers and tenants).
- `installed_at` (String) When the installed document was installed. RFC 3339 in UTC.
- `instance_id` (String) This platform's instance id, which a licence document binds.
- `licence_class` (String) The licence class.
- `licence_epoch` (Number) The installed document's epoch.
- `licence_id` (String) The installed licence's id.
- `modules` (List of String) Entitled modules; empty unless the state gives full function.
- `overlays` (List of String) Conditions shown next to the state: `clock_skew`, `over_deployed`.
- `product_code` (String) The licensed product.
- `serial` (String, Sensitive) The licence serial: in full for a token holding `licence-admin-global`, masked to its last group otherwise. **Sensitive.**
- `serial_masked` (Boolean) True when `serial` is masked for this token.
- `sockets` (Attributes) `licensed` (null when uncapped or unlicensed), `uncapped`, and `observed` (what the latest census measured; null before the first). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sockets))
- `sp_mode_enabled` (Boolean) The licence lets the service-provider plane (customers and tenants) change.
- `state` (String) `UNLICENSED`, `PENDING_ACTIVATION`, `INVALID`, `DOMAIN_MISMATCH`, `ACTIVE`, `EXPIRING`, `GRACE`, `LOCKED` or `REVOKED`.
- `state_reason` (String) Why the licence is in this state; empty when `ACTIVE`.
- `tenancy_mode` (String) `single` or `multi`.
- `tier` (String) The licensed tier.
- `valid_from` (String) Start of the term. RFC 3339 in UTC.
- `valid_until` (String) End of the term. RFC 3339 in UTC.
- `writes_allowed` (Boolean) The licence lets ordinary changes through; false only when read-only.

<a id="nestedatt--sockets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sockets`

Read-Only:

- `licensed` (Number) Sockets the licence allows.
- `observed` (Number) Sockets the latest census measured.
- `uncapped` (Boolean) No socket limit.
